newsitem.title: ESTONIA: RAKVERE SURPRISED BY SUSPENSION, PROBE.
newsitem.headline: RAKVERE SURPRISED BY SUSPENSION, PROBE.

text.p: Rakvere meat factory said on Thursday that the trade suspension in its shares and the start of an investigation into insider dealing in its shares was unexpected.
"Rakvere meat factory does not know anything about deals made by persons who owned confidential information," it said in a statement.
"The trade suspension in Rakvere shares was in the interest of every shareholder," the company added.
It said that the suspension and criminal charges would not change its financial results.
The Tallinn bourse on Wednesday suspended trade in Rakvere shares as the police started investigation into alleged insider dealing in its shares. The bourse restarted the trade today.
